summary: The source already installs a Galileo processor on its native OTel provider. The supplied scenario selects Galileo-native project, production stream and consumed runtime binding only.
The operator profile disagrees with Make dev’s project override. No installed-client, local-runtime, resource-existence or remote-delivery proof has run for this supplied audit.

evidence.finding: Galileo2.7-to-before3 and native OTel dependencies are declared.
app.py creates the provider and Galileo processor; agent.py reuses that provider for model-directed replay and drains it.
GALILEO_PROJECT is passed to the processor; the supplied original profile names existing-vendor-project and production while Make dev forces another project.
Streaming workflow/chat/tool operations and a separate replay agent/model/tool loop are source-owned.
